content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RMC Zonal Manager-UWM Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Zonal Manager-UWM in RMC?
faq.answer: Rajkot Municipal Corporation (RMC) has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Zonal Manager-UWM post through this recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the official notification for detailed information.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for RMC Zonal Manager-UWM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RMC Zonal Manager-UWM post is "Walk-in". Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for the RMC Zonal Manager-UWM post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Zonal Manager-UWM position at Rajkot Municipal Corporation is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Zonal Manager-UWM?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Zonal Manager-UWM post must hold a B.E./B.Tech degree in Civil, Environment, Mechanical, or Water Resource engineering, along with 2 years of relevant experience after graduation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Zonal Manager-UWM position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Zonal Manager-UWM post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 3,50,000/- per month. This is a fixed salary for the contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the RMC Zonal Manager-UWM recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the RMC Zonal Manager-UWM recruitment. Candidates from all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Zonal Manager-UWM post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Zonal Manager-UWM position primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in the interview and have their documents verified.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview for RMC Zonal Manager-UWM be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Rajkot Municipal Corporation (RMC) office in Rajkot, Gujarat. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue address and reporting time.

faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable). Extra passport-size photographs are also recommended.
